Thus an empty-snapshot A may publish after B appends a PIT-visible row; this is a plausible interleaving, NOT a reproduced defect.

Snapshot bytes of all three output files after B; release A, join with bounded timeouts, check exitcodes and A/B counts, verify all three final JSON parse, compare bytes to B snapshots, and verify nested final rowB provenance. Distinguish fixture, child exception, timeout, model/JSON failures from true stale-publication mismatch. No production edits, network, sleeps as timing oracle, skips or xfail.
